info.title: Appy fixture controller API
info.description: Fixed-fixture development implementation. Default controller is loopback-only. Optional private mobile gateway requires an exact HTTPS Tailscale origin and an expiring paired-browser session for workspace, tasks and downloads. Mac-only pairing administration is never available through the gateway. No real device control, models or credentials. Remote POSTs require exact Origin; no CORS. Pairing operations are ephemeral and are not journaled or replayed by Idempotency-Key; inspect current session/access state after an uncertain response.

post.description: All actions require expected_revision matching the current task. approve and deny also require the current approval_id; approve rejects expiry. refresh_approval replaces the approval ID and expiry for unchanged preview. start: draft→queued; pause: queued/running→paused; resume: paused→queued; cancel: any nonterminal→cancelled; approve: waiting_approval→succeeded; deny: waiting_approval→cancelled. Invalid transitions and stale revisions return409. The runner only analyzes embedded fixtures. It cannot execute the goal as a command.

post.description: stop_all durably closes admission and cancels all nonterminal tasks, including drafts; repeated stop is safe. enable_new_tasks permits new drafts only and never revives cancelled work. All effects in this development slice are journal writes.

200.description: Approved fixture report. Content-Disposition attachment; no user-supplied download path.

get.description: Public session status; local controller is trusted on loopback. Remote session tokens are never returned in JSON.

post.description: Remote only. Consume one current Mac-created invitation, valid for five minutes and at most five incorrect guesses. Issues an eight-hour Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict __Host-appy_session cookie. No idempotency replay; after a lost response inspect GET session before trying again.
Remote only. Revoke current browser session and clear cookie.

get.description: Local Mac only. Current invite and browser sessions; unavailable through gateway.

post.description: Local Mac only. Replaces any current invite. No idempotency replay; inspect GET access after an uncertain response.
Local Mac only. Revoke browser session; does not cancel already-authorized task work.
Local Mac only. Revoke all browser sessions and current invitation; does not cancel task work.

Approval.description: The preview is already stored in the task journal. Approval promotes these exact bytes to a downloadable local artifact.

goal.description: A human-readable label for the fixed bundled recipe, never executable instructions.
